<h2>Interpolate One Fossil Age-Iteration Batch</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Expands one fossil community dataset across selected age-model iterations
and interpolates each taxon-iteration series on a shared age grid.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>.interpolate_fossil_age_iteration_batch(
  vec_iterations,
  dataset_name,
  data_community,
  data_age_uncertainty,
  list_interpolation_arguments,
  interpolate_grouped_time_series_function
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="vec_iterations">vec_iterations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Integer age-model iterations included in the batch.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="dataset_name">dataset_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Dataset identifier restored after joining the nested community records.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_community">data_community</code></td>
<td>
<p>Nested community proportions with 'sample_name', 'taxon', and 'value'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_age_uncertainty">data_age_uncertainty</code></td>
<td>
<p>Nested age-model records with 'sample_name', 'iteration', and
'age_uncertainty'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_interpolation_arguments">list_interpolation_arguments</code></td>
<td>
<p>Additional arguments forwarded to [interpolate_grouped_time_series()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="interpolate_grouped_time_series_function">interpolate_grouped_time_series_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Grouped interpolation function supplied explicitly for dependency-safe
execution inside a dynamic target branch.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Interpolated community proportions for every selected age-model iteration.
</p>

</main>
